warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-4 at 2.00 + 3.00 + 3.00 (8.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.00 + 3.00 + 2.00 (8.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, A-03, A-07 and A-08 and all agree. Vector PDF with the dimension text drawn as lines (no usable text layer) — every value read off the rendered page.

Sub-chains miss their totals by 0.01 in four places: S-02/A-03 x 0.93 + 1.08 against 2.00 (1-2); S-02/A-03 y 1.08 + 1.93 against 3.00 (B-C), 1.08 + 0.93 against 2.00 (C-D); S-02 y 1.58 + 1.43 against 3.00 (A-B). Looks like 0.925 / 1.075 / 1.575 / 1.425 rounded up on print. Inner ticks are positioned off the line above / to the left (A+1.58, B+1.08, C+1.08, 1+0.93); the 0.01 is absorbed by the last segment of each group.

y 1.50 (A-03) and 1.58 (S-02) both sit in A-B, 0.08 apart: two different printed ticks (A-03 floor-plan dimension vs the S-02 beam B1 line), kept as two lines. Beam B1 between slabs S1 and GS uses the S-02 value (structural sheet wins for structural geometry).

Two edge families sit 0.08 apart all round: the GS ground-slab edge 1.08 outside the outer grids (S-02, A-03, A-07, A-08) and the roof edge 1.00 outside (S-03). Different printed edges, kept as separate lines (1'/1'', 4'/4'', A'/A'', D'/D''); likewise 0.93 vs 1.00 on x and 4.00 vs 4.08, 7.00 vs 7.08 on y.

TRUSS T1-T4 elevations (S-04) print no grid bubbles. Their chains are placed by their supports as drawn on the S-03 roof frame plan: T1 runs C (T3 end) - B (T2) - A (อะเส) on grids 2, 3 and 4; T2 runs along B from grid 1 (T4) to grid 4; T3 along C from grid 2 to grid 4; T4 along grid 1 from B (T2) to A (อะเส). Their 3.00 / 6.00 / 8.00 sub-totals match those grid gaps exactly. Every 1.000 panel tick became a line (rule 4).

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-06, the floor plan A-03 and the building sections A-07/A-08 (levels). Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: elevations A-05/A-06, roof plan A-04, sanitary and door/window details A-09/A-10, E-01, SN-01/SN-02. S-05/S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (footing and section sizes, slab thickness, lean/sand layers), which stay on their elements; the S-04 truss depths (0.840, 0.418, 0.787, 0.472) are member-internal too.
The bottom GS and the bottom-right GS ground slabs meet at about 3 + 1.08 (6.08) on x — scaled off S-02/A-03, printed nowhere — so no line is made for it; those slab refs name the bay only.
